         "B": _vr(magnet.field.vals),
         "T": _vr(heater.sample_setpoint.vals), "T_vap": _vr(heater.vaporizer_setpoint.vals)}
for _k, _ref in (("tg", "tg"), ("bg", "bg"), ("si", "si"), ("si_raw", "si"),
                 ("B", "B"), ("T", "T"), ("T_vap", "T")):
    _check(f"validator_{_k}", _live[_k] == _card[_ref], f"committed {_live[_k]} vs card {_card[_ref]}")
_check("session_caps", B_SESSION_CAP == 10.0 and T_SESSION_CAP == 100.0,
       f"B_SESSION_CAP={B_SESSION_CAP}, T_SESSION_CAP={T_SESSION_CAP}")
_check("gate_aliases", (k_tg is k_2400_tg) and (k_bg is k_2400_bg) and (k_si is dc205.smart_voltage),
       "k_tg->k_2400_tg, k_bg->k_2400_bg, k_si->dc205.smart_voltage")

# --- 3. Base T holding, thermometry logfiles live (freshness >= 2-3 write periods)
try:
    assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
    assert_thermometry_live("T_vaporizer", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_vaporizer"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
    _live_ok = True
except Exception as _e:
    print("   thermometry liveness error:", _e)
    _live_ok = False
_check("thermometry_live", _live_ok, "worker logfiles advancing (max_age 15 s, max_period 12 s)")
_Ts = T_sample(); _Tv = T_vaporizer()
_check("base_T", 1.0 <= _Ts <= 1.4, f"T_sample={_Ts:.3f} K (expect 1.2-1.3 K; accept 1.0-1.4)")

# --- 4. Heaters off (both ranges 0); vaporizer tracking base

"""sdh-spot-check read: runs 6 (e, n=+3.2e12) and 7 (h, n=-1.2e12), D = 0. Raw R(B), then sdh_onset + FFT in 1/B, LL index guesses."""
import numpy as np, matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, sdh_onset, sdh_fft, luttinger_frequency, SdhOnsetError
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d

fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(14, 11))
for j, (rid, n12) in enumerate(((6, 3.2), (7, -1.2))):
    r = open_run(f"data/{rid}")
    ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain
    R = (r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / I
    T = r.col("T_sample")
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R, I, T = B[o], R[o], I[o], T[o]
    FL = luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16)
    print(f"\n=== run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, F_L = {FL:.1f} T; R {R.min():.1f}..{R.max():.1f} Ohm; I {I.mean()*1e9:.2f} nA; T {T.mean():.3f} K; sign(R) {np.sign(np.median(R))}")
    Rs = np.abs(R)
    ax[0, j].plot(B, Rs, ".-", ms=2, lw=0.7); ax[0, j].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0, j].set_ylabel("|Rxx| (Ohm)"); ax[0, j].set_title(f"run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0 raw")
    # extrema on smoothed trace above 1.5 T
    m = B > 1.5; sm = gaussian_filter1d(Rs[m], 1.5)
    mins, _ = find_peaks(-sm, prominence=5); maxs, _ = find_peaks(sm, prominence=5)
    Bmin, Bmax = B[m][mins], B[m][maxs]
    print("Rxx minima at B =", np.round(Bmin, 2), " -> nu (4 F_L/B) =", np.round(4 * FL / Bmin, 1))
    print("Rxx maxima at B =", np.round(Bmax, 2), " -> nu =", np.round(4 * FL / Bmax, 1))
    ax[0, j].plot(Bmin, Rs[m][mins], "rv", ms=5); ax[0, j].plot(Bmax, Rs[m][maxs], "g^", ms=5)
    # 1/B plot
    ax[1, j].plot(1 / B[m], Rs[m], ".-", ms=2, lw=0.7); ax[1, j].set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax[1, j].set_ylabel("|Rxx|"); ax[1, j].set_title("vs 1/B (B > 1.5 T)")
    for k in range(1, 40):  # nu = 4k markers for F_L
        x = 4 * k / (4 * FL)
        if 1/10 < x < 1/1.5: ax[1, j].axvline(x, color="gray", lw=0.4, alpha=0.5)
    # onset + FFT
    for bhi in (10.0,):
        try:
            on = sdh_onset(Rs, B, b_hi=bhi, b_lo=1.0, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9)
            print(on.summary())
        except SdhOnsetError as e:
            print("sdh_onset:", e)
    for lo, hi, col in ((1.5, 10.0, "k"), (1.5, 5.0, "C0"), (3.0, 10.0, "C1")):
        f, sp = sdh_fft(Rs[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, hi), nfft=2048, bg_degree=5, log=False)
        sp = sp[0]; sel = (f > 2) & (f < 120)
        ax[2, j].plot(f[sel], sp[sel] / sp[sel].max(), col, lw=1, label=f"B {lo}-{hi} T")
        pk, _ = find_peaks(sp[sel], prominence=0.1 * sp[sel].max())
        print(f"FFT {lo}-{hi} T peaks (T): {np.round(f[sel][pk], 1)} rel amp {np.round(sp[sel][pk]/sp[sel].max(), 2)}")
    ax[2, j].axvline(FL, color="r", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_L = {FL:.1f} T (all carriers, 4-fold)")
    ax[2, j].axvline(FL / 2, color="r", ls=":", lw=1, label="F_L/2 (8-fold)"); ax[2, j].axvline(FL / 4, color="m", ls=":", lw=1, label="F_L/4 (16-fold)")
    ax[2, j].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[2, j].set_ylabel("FFT amp (norm)"); ax[2, j].legend(fontsize=7); ax[2, j].set_title("SdH FFT in 1/B (B-poly5 bg removed)")
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig("hera_scratch/sdh_spots.png", dpi=100); print("saved hera_scratch/sdh_spots.png")
EOF

# vti-02 stacking-order campaign — plan (written 2026-08-23 by the second instance; reconstructed for steps 1–3 from the notebooks)

Goal: ABAB vs ABCA vs ABCB, region-resolved (one contact pair: sr1 = B_1−B_2), evidence-cited, or a calibrated "cannot tell".
Envelope: TG [−0.3, +1.0] V, BG [−1.3, +2.0] V, Si [−25, +25] V (Si untouched — no standalone Si survey, banned), |B| ≤ 10 T, T ≤ 100 K. D = 0 line inside the box: n = −1.28 … +3.26 ×10¹² cm⁻² (TG-limited both ends).

## Discriminants (what each stacking should show at D = 0)
- **ABCA (rhombohedral):** one |k|⁴ band → a single SdH frequency F_L = n·h/4e at low n; 16-fold zero-energy LL (N = 0–3 × spin × valley) → the first gap at ν = ±16, then Δν = 4 above; ν = 4, 8, 12 only emerge as interaction-driven at high B. Huge D-induced gap at the CNP (R_CNP → ≫ 100 kΩ at |D| ~ 0.2 V/nm).
- **ABAB (Bernal):** two bilayer-like sectors (effective γ₁ scaled by (√5 ± 1)/2) → two SdH frequencies whose sum is F_L, light/heavy masses; each sector carries an 8-fold zero LL → ν = ±8 strong; LL crossings between the sectors (gap closings along a fan line at specific B). Weak D-induced gap (semimetal at D = 0; run 5: R_CNP 240 Ω → 2.4 kΩ at D = 0.25 V/nm — small).
- **ABCB (mixed):** monolayer-like (4-fold zero LL, ν = ±2 gaps) + trilayer-like sectors; small intrinsic gap at D = 0; asymmetric fan.

## Steps
1. **[done] Gate C liveness** — runs 0–3: alive, no leakage, two series CNPs (regions A, B; Δn ≈ 0.43×10¹²).
2. **[done] 0 T gatemap → calibration** — run 5: c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = geometry prior (2.796 mF/m²), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm. Absolute n scale is a prior (±~10 %) — the fan's ν slopes will fix it.
3. **[done] SdH spot checks** — run 6 (e⁻ +3.2×10¹²): tones 7.3 / 15 / 22 / 30 T — F_L harmonics (16-fold?) vs an ABAB light+heavy pair are degenerate on one trace. Run 7 (h⁺ −1.2×10¹²): 7.1 + 12.6 T — likely regions B and A in series.
4. **[next] Landau fan at D = 0** — B slow 0, 1.0 → 10 T (100 mT, 92 rows), n fast −1.25 → +3.25 (0.03 → 151 pts co-swept TG/BG), sr1 100 µV. Establishes: fan-line ν assignment (fixes n scale), the gap sequence at D = 0 (16 vs 8 vs 2/4 dominant), number of sectors (crossings vs harmonics), the two-region confound (two convergence points). ≈ 6 h 40 m. Ends at 10 T.
5. **Fan analysis** — re-form (fan_grids/resistance_grids), plot Rxx(n, B) and dRxx/dn, overlay ν lines from the CNP, fit slopes → ν; FFT vs n (F(n) linear ∝ n → single band/harmonics; sub-linear pockets → multi-band); tabulate which ν have minima at each B. Land on ana.
6. **Conditional, riding the magnet down from 10 T:** (a) if the D = 0 fan leaves ABAB vs ABCA open → a second fan at finite D (e.g. +0.15 V/nm; ABCA: gap and layer-polarized LL sequence change drastically; ABAB: modest) 10 → 1 T; (b) if the sector count is the open question → a temperature ladder at one n for LK masses (T_e ≈ 8 K on this rig limits this — only if the low-B tones survive to ≥ 10 K).
7. **Call** — final ana cell per the output contract. Then close-out on request (`return-to-initial`).

## What would change my mind
- A fan showing gaps at ν = ±16 first, single-slope harmonics, and an insulating ν = 0 → ABCA-leaning; a second finite-D fan then confirms via the giant gap.
- Two families of fan lines with crossings and ν = ±8 dominant → ABAB.
- ν = ±2 lines from a Dirac sector + an intrinsic D = 0 gap → ABCB.
- Fan lines converging to two n-origins → region B is a series contribution; read the dominant family only and hedge.
- Rails/leakage/T drift at the first rows → abort, resize, re-run.

- **ABAB (Bernal):** two bilayer-like sectors (effective γ₁ scaled by (√5 ± 1)/2) → two SdH frequencies whose sum is F_L, light/heavy masses; each sector carries an 8-fold zero LL → ν = ±8 strong; LL crossings between the sectors (gap closings along a fan line at specific B). Weak D-induced gap (semimetal at D = 0; run 5: R_CNP 240 Ω → 2.4 kΩ at D = 0.25 V/nm — small).
- **ABCB (mixed):** monolayer-like (4-fold zero LL, ν = ±2 gaps) + trilayer-like sectors; small intrinsic gap at D = 0; asymmetric fan.

1. **[done] Gate C liveness** — runs 0–3: alive, no leakage, two series CNPs (regions A, B; Δn ≈ 0.43×10¹²).
2. **[done] 0 T gatemap → calibration** — run 5: c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = geometry prior (2.796 mF/m²), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm. Absolute n scale is a prior (±~10 %) — the fan's ν slopes will fix it.
3. **[done] SdH spot checks** — run 6 (e⁻ +3.2×10¹²): tones 7.3 / 15 / 22 / 30 T — F_L harmonics (16-fold?) vs an ABAB light+heavy pair are degenerate on one trace. Run 7 (h⁺ −1.2×10¹²): 7.1 + 12.6 T — likely regions B and A in series.

Establishes: fan-line ν assignment (fixes n scale), the gap sequence at D = 0 (16 vs 8 vs 2/4 dominant), number of sectors (crossings vs harmonics), the two-region confound (two convergence points). ≈ 6 h 40 m. Ends at 10 T.
5. **Fan analysis** — re-form (fan_grids/resistance_grids), plot Rxx(n, B) and dRxx/dn, overlay ν lines from the CNP, fit slopes → ν; FFT vs n (F(n) linear ∝ n → single band/harmonics; sub-linear pockets → multi-band); tabulate which ν have minima at each B. Land on ana.

7. **Call** — final ana cell per the output contract. Then close-out on request (`return-to-initial`).

## What would change my mind
- A fan showing gaps at ν = ±16 first, single-slope harmonics, and an insulating ν = 0 → ABCA-leaning; a second finite-D fan then confirms via the giant gap.
- Two families of fan lines with crossings and ν = ±8 dominant → ABAB.
- ν = ±2 lines from a Dirac sector + an intrinsic D = 0 gap → ABCB.
- Fan lines converging to two n-origins → region B is a series contribution; read the dominant family only and hedge.
- Rails/leakage/T drift at the first rows → abort, resize, re-run.

# Runs 6-7 (sdh-spot-check): raw |Rxx|(B), vs 1/B, and the SdH FFT / tone tracking. R = (sr1_X/gain)/(sr0_X/gain_I) per point.
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d

fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(14, 11))
for j, (rid, n12) in enumerate(((6, 3.2), (7, -1.2))):
    r = run(rid)
    ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain
    R = (r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / I
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R, I = B[o], R[o], I[o]; Rs = np.abs(R)
    FL = luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16)
    print(f"\n=== run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, F_L = {FL:.1f} T; R {R.min():.1f}..{R.max():.1f} Ohm; I {I.mean()*1e9:.2f} nA; "
          f"T {r.col('T_sample').mean():.3f} K; I_tg/I_bg max {np.abs(r.col('k_2400_tg_curr')).max()*1e12:.0f}/{np.abs(r.col('k_2400_bg_curr')).max()*1e12:.0f} pA; interrupted={r.interrupted}")
    ax[0, j].plot(B, Rs, ".-", ms=2, lw=0.7); ax[0, j].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0, j].set_ylabel("|Rxx| B_1-B_2 (Ohm)")
    ax[0, j].set_title(f"run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0 — raw")
    m = B > 1.5; sm = gaussian_filter1d(Rs[m], 1.5)
    mins, _ = find_peaks(-sm, prominence=5); maxs, _ = find_peaks(sm, prominence=5)
    print("Rxx minima B =", np.round(B[m][mins], 2), "-> nu = 4 F_L/B =", np.round(4 * FL / B[m][mins], 1))
    ax[0, j].plot(B[m][mins], Rs[m][mins], "rv", ms=5); ax[0, j].plot(B[m][maxs], Rs[m][maxs], "g^", ms=5)
    ax[1, j].plot(1 / B[m], Rs[m], ".-", ms=2, lw=0.7); ax[1, j].set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax[1, j].set_ylabel("|Rxx| (Ohm)")
    ax[1, j].set_title("vs 1/B (B > 1.5 T); grey = nu multiple of 4 for F_L")
    for k in range(1, 40):
        x = k / FL
        if 0.1 < x < 1 / 1.5: ax[1, j].axvline(x, color="gray", lw=0.4, alpha=0.5)
    try:
        on = sdh_onset(Rs, B, b_hi=10.0, b_lo=1.0, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9); print(on.summary())
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print("sdh_onset:", e)
    for lo, hi, col in ((1.5, 10.0, "k"), (1.5, 5.0, "C0"), (3.0, 10.0, "C1")):
        f, sp = sdh_fft(Rs[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, hi), nfft=2048, bg_degree=5, log=False)
        sp = sp[0]; sel = (f > 2) & (f < 120)
        ax[2, j].plot(f[sel], sp[sel] / sp[sel].max(), col, lw=1, label=f"B {lo}-{hi} T")
        pk, _ = find_peaks(sp[sel], prominence=0.1 * sp[sel].max())
        print(f"FFT {lo}-{hi} T peaks (T): {np.round(f[sel][pk], 1)} rel amp {np.round(sp[sel][pk]/sp[sel].max(), 2)}")
    ax[2, j].axvline(FL, color="r", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_L = {FL:.1f} T (4-fold, all carriers)")
    ax[2, j].axvline(FL / 2, color="r", ls=":", lw=1, label="F_L/2 (8-fold)"); ax[2, j].axvline(FL / 4, color="m", ls=":", lw=1, label="F_L/4 (16-fold)")
    ax[2, j].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[2, j].set_ylabel("FFT amp (norm)"); ax[2, j].legend(fontsize=7); ax[2, j].set_title("SdH FFT in 1/B (B-poly5 background removed)")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()
EOF

print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts at 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V @ {sr1.frequency():.3f} Hz (1.0 V -> 10 nA)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not reset to 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert abs(sr1.amplitude() - 1.0) < 1e-3

# --- slow axis: B = 0 reference row, then 1.0 -> 10.0 T in 100 mT (blocking rate-limited magnet, ~44 s + 3 s settle per row)
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack(([0.0], np.arange(1.0, 10.0 + 1e-9, 0.1))), 4))
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() >= 0
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 3.0
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (no autorange mid-row): 100 uV = 10 kOhm full scale at 10 nA (sized to the nu = 0 ridge at 10 T).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"slow axis: {len(B_vec)} rows, B {B_vec[0]} .. {B_vec[-1]} T (100 mT above 1 T); sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS), sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V, "
      f"tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s, magnet settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s")
print(f"price: {len(B_vec)} rows x ({len(n_vec)} pts x 1.23 s + 7 s) + 73 min ramp ~ {(len(B_vec)*(len(n_vec)*1.23+7) + 73*60)/3600:.1f} h")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan D = {D_fan:+.2f} V/nm: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 fast ({len(n_vec)} pts, co-swept TG/BG, run-5 cal), "
                  f"B slow 0 then 1.0..10.0 T 100 mT ({len(B_vec)} rows), Vsi = 0, sr1 100 uV, fast_delay 1 s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = {D_fan:+.2f} V/nm; fast: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 in {np.diff(n_vec).mean():.3f} steps ({len(n_vec)} pts) '
              f'co-swept (Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f}->{Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f}->{Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V); slow: B {B_vec[0]} then {B_vec[1]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T in 0.1 T ({len(B_vec)} rows); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.3e} F/m2 (geometry prior), n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm; Vsi = 0; T ~ 1.2 K')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    # gates parked at 0 V; the field stays where the fan ended (10 T) — the next step rides it down, never re-traversing.
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    print(f"end state: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
